title: Combine recursive invoices with exact multiplicities and source receipts
body:
Repeated components currently require manual paid/target histogram edits before comparison. Add `combine_recursive_invoices.py` to sum both sides with positive integer multiplicities under one matching declared contract. It writes a normal comparator-compatible invoice to stdout and an exact input/output hash receipt to stderr. No output is emitted until all terms and aggregate limits pass.

Use `python3 -B scripts/combine_recursive_invoices.py --term 3 A.json --term 2 B.json > combined.json 2> receipt.json`. The guide states the independent physical-composition and target-ownership obligations. κ values must not be added. Existing comparator bytes are unchanged.

Validation: 15 invoice/comparator tests pass on Python 3.12; the 5 new tests also pass under `-O`. Controls replay costs under independent tariffs, preserve input data, check duplicate terms, reject overflow/contract changes and bind real isolated optimized CLI output bytes to its receipt. A late invalid term emits no partial invoice. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main, priority revision 7, live PR paths and Discussions checked. Guide additions occupy a separate section from PR5731/5732; there is no dependency on them. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `470df91df2ab6e4ada410f6635e7159bf076a5e5`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
